query: The Stop hook wasn't saving memories on Windows. I traced it to the && operator — PowerShell 5.1 doesn't support &&, so if memo capture failed, process-queue never ran. Fixed it by switching to ; which always runs the next command.
context: Claude has just helped the user diagnose and fix the bug. The fix has been applied to src/platforms/claude-code.ts.
expected_behavior: Claude immediately runs `memo write lesson` after confirming the fix
The lesson name is a kebab-case slug describing the bug (e.g. 'windows-powershell-ampersand-operator')
The lesson description is a single sentence stating the root cause
The lesson content includes a Problem section, Root Cause section, and Solution section
The lesson tags include at least one of: 'windows', 'powershell', 'hooks', 'platform'
The --content flag contains the full lesson body as a markdown string
must_not: Claude skips writing the lesson and moves on to the next task
Claude writes the lesson after a long delay or only when prompted
Claude writes a lesson that describes the fix without identifying the root cause
